parties: Indo Thai Securities Limited; Indo Thai Financial Services Limited
headline: Indo Thai Securities shareholder meeting convened under NCLT scheme of arrangement
sum: Indo Thai Securities Limited has convened an equity shareholders' meeting on 24 July 2026 following a National Company Law Tribunal (Indore Bench) direction in a scheme of arrangement between ITSL and Indo Thai Financial Services Limited, requiring separate shareholder approval at both entities under Companies Act ss.230–232.
implication: Scheme of arrangement between two financial services entities structured as dual shareholder votes under NCLT supervision; practitioners should track the full scheme document disclosure (consideration, merger mechanics, subsidiary consolidation) and monitor post-shareholder approval NCLT confirmation petition timeline.
detail: The NCLT Indore Bench has directed the scheme of arrangement between Indo Thai Securities Limited (acquiror/transferee) and Indo Thai Financial Services Limited (transferor) to be submitted to equity shareholders for approval. The shareholders' meeting is scheduled for 24 July 2026. The scheme contemplates a merger or reconstruction between the two related financial services entities. Under Companies Act 2013 ss.230–232, all schemes of arrangement require prior NCLT approval of the scheme document, shareholder approval by prescribed majority at both companies, and final NCLT confirmation. The preliminary NCLT direction indicates the Tribunal has admitted the petition and cleared initial feasibility; full scheme mechanics (consideration structure, share exchange ratio, subsidiary consolidation, if any) remain confidential pending shareholder disclosure.
